components.bow_opening: Each directly visible hole or bounded opening through the key head; exclude surface shadows, reflections and decorative outlines.
components.shaft_bands: Each visible physical band or collar encircling the key shaft, described by position and visible shape. Do not infer conventional key anatomy or hidden bands.
components.blade_edge_cutouts: Each distinct directly visible notch or cutout in the edge of the key blade. Distinguish actual edge geometry from shadows and reflections.
components.blade_shaft_contacts: Each distinct visible physical contact site where key blade and shaft meet. Separate contact sites by visible location; do not infer occluded connections.
